name: How long does it take to build a detached ADU?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to build a detached ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for building a detached ADU varies but generally ranges from 6 to 12 months from initial design to completion. This includes several phases: design and architectural planning (1-2 months), permit approval (2-4 months, depending on the municipality), and actual construction (3-6 months). Unexpected delays due to weather, material availability, or inspection schedules can sometimes extend the project duration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Building a detached ADU typically takes 6 to 12 months, including design, permitting, and construction phases.
